mainEntity.name: How does functional fitness differ from general exercise for pregnant women?

acceptedAnswer.text: Functional fitness focuses on movements that mimic everyday activities, building practical strength and mobility directly applicable to the physical demands of pregnancy, labor, and caring for a newborn. Unlike general exercise which might isolate muscles, functional training at Cave Training integrates multiple muscle groups and emphasizes core stability and proper movement patterns. This approach ensures you're not just strong, but functionally capable of handling the changing physical stresses of pregnancy with greater ease and efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Functional fitness builds practical strength for everyday pregnancy demands, unlike general exercise that may isolate muscles. Cave Training's approach integrates multiple muscle groups for core stability and efficient movement.
